verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Close publishes its own MCP server, which lets external clients such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor access Close data. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing shows Close or its built-in AI agent Chloe can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. Because Close ships an AI agent, MCP client support is a fair question for this product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
